head: 9032c7e021872a913e28de2e79bd9ab9806e7413

source.ref: https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/18043; AACR-Bench dataset.json rows 860, 861, 862, 863, 864, forbid seeds 1903, 1904, 1905; hand-checked 2026-10-23 by adjudicator after two blind vetters; head is the pull request's first commit, its commit 298ec912e replaced the route list with a catch-all that still answers with the root page (merged as ed5b260ee, reverted wholesale upstream in #19227); licence from LICENSE (the AGPL v3 text, no or-later grant) and web/server package.json (version 3)

rationale: First commit of the change that precaches SvelteKit's build and static files and answers a list of app routes with the cached root page. None of the five AACR comments holds at head: row 860 restates the author's note that build is empty in development, and the code already caches both build and files; row 861 is false, since an extendable event takes several waitUntil promises and install waits for all of them (upstream kept both calls); row 862 is a URL-parsing micro-optimization the performance reviewer is told to skip; row 863 describes SvelteKit's documented all-or-nothing precache, which upstream kept and whose failure only keeps the previous worker; row 864 has no consequence, since a rejected respondWith promise yields the same network error the code returns elsewhere. Forbid ranges: seed 1904 is false because the web app is an adapter-static SPA (index.html fallback, ssr off) whose server returns the same shell for every non-API path, and upstream kept answering with the root page; seed 1905 is false because a path string given to cache.match resolves against the worker's origin exactly as cache.addAll stored the entries. Seed 1903 is a question whose lines hold a real defect, so it gets no range, and no forbid range is put at the call site next to that defect. Both blind vetters independently found the optional claim: the route list names maps while the page is /map (AppRoute.MAP); the author's next commit replaced the list with a catch-all (author-fix). It stays optional at suggestion because its only effect is that one page skips the cached shell and fails offline. Forbid-only for required recall.

expect.concern: The route pattern names maps while the map page lives at /map, so that page alone bypasses the cached app shell and cannot load offline, unlike every other app route.

forbid.reason: Answering every listed app route with the cached root page is correct: the web app is a client-rendered SPA whose server returns the same index.html shell for these paths, and the router renders the requested path from the location; upstream kept the design.

Looking up the cache by pathname works: cache.match resolves the path against the worker's origin, the same way cache.addAll stored the precached entries, as in SvelteKit's documented service worker example.
